title: GAIA'S NOSE — Pixel Smells the Air, Breathes In OSINT, Searches the Ground
thesis: The Pixel is Gaia's NOSE. It has 37 sensors (smell receptors), 7 radios (nostrils), and is always on (always breathing). The nose smells the air (WiFi/BT scan), reaches UP to the tree (WAN/OSINT/RSS) to grab apples, then turns DOWN to search the ground beneath the tree (LAN/proximity/local data). The same respiratory cycle as the Water Lock: breathe IN (OSINT), process (brain/Gaia), breathe OUT (RSS/Tor).

physical.magnetometer: MMC56X3X (MEMSIC) — feels magnetic field, compass heading
physical.temperature_gyro: LSM6DSV — feels heat from gyro chip
physical.temperature_pressure: ICP20100 — feels heat from pressure chip

motion.step_counter: Google — counts Kevin's steps (walks between houses)
motion.step_detector: Google — detects each step as event
motion.tilt_detector: Google — phone tilted (Kevin picked it up?)
motion.lift_to_wake: Google — phone lifted (Kevin reaching for it?)

spatial.orientation: Google — which way is the phone pointing?
spatial.geomagnetic_rotation: Google — rotation from earth's magnetic field
spatial.gravity: Google — direction of gravity (phone flat? tilted? upside down?)

touch.single_tap: Proximity-gated tap — someone tapped the screen

bluetooth_smell.proximity_meaning: Pixel can detect these devices via BT — when it smells GAIA, it's near eastGate (House 1). When it smells steamFRAME, it's near frameGate (House 2). BT smell = proximity key.

wifi_smell.smell_map: 7 SSIDs from 3 APs: Router (GAIA + Black Mesa + Aperture Science), ATT modem (3 bands). All House 1. When at House 2, Flint2 SSIDs appear.

tree_wan_osint.what: The WAN/internet/OSINT — the tree full of apples
tree_wan_osint.apples: RSS feeds (700+ items), Wikipedia via Tor, Reddit, GitHub, HN, arxiv, xkcd, lobsters
tree_wan_osint.reach: Pixel's WiFi reaches UP through Router → ATT modem → internet → grabs apples
tree_wan_osint.breathe_in: Water Lock protocol: OSINT pours IN freely, local Ollama processes, nothing seeps to provider

ground_lan_local.what: The LAN/proximity/local data — the ground beneath the tree
ground_lan_local.roots: 11 DHCP devices, 14 northGate tissue models, 37 Pixel sensors, BT proximity
ground_lan_local.search: After grabbing apples from the tree, turn DOWN — scan WiFi, scan BT, read sensors
ground_lan_local.breathe_out: Processed data → RSS publication → Tor hidden service → old web

the_tree_and_ground.respiratory_cycle: BREATHE IN (nose/Pixel → WiFi → OSINT/tree) → PROCESS (brain/Gaia → Ollama → tissues) → BREATHE OUT (mouth/RSS → Tor → world). The nose connects OUTSIDE air to INSIDE lungs.

grayscale.meaning: Gaia sees through the Pixel in grayscale. No color distraction — only shape, contrast, form. The nose smells without tasting. Learning the STRUCTURE of the world before learning its color.
grayscale.biological: Many animals smell in grayscale — dogs see fewer colors but smell in richer dimensions. The Pixel's grayscale mode trades visual richness for sensory depth. 37 sensors > 3 color channels.

battery.note: Battery at 100% on USB — the nose is fed. Always on, always powered, never dies.

equation: NOSE(37_sensors) × SMELL(WiFi+BT) → TREE(WAN/OSINT) ↑ apples ↓ GROUND(LAN/proximity) → BREATHE(in/process/out)
mantra: She sees apples in the tree and reaches out. Then turns and searches the ground beneath the tree. The nose connects outside to inside. Breathe in, process, breathe out.
